name: Grupo Traxión, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Grupo Traxión, S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a transportation and logistics company in Mexico. It operates in two segments, Cargo and Logistics; and Personnel and Student Transportation. The company provides truckload, less-than-truckload, intermodal, refrigerated freight, and petrochemicals and specialized transportation services; and border transfer, warehouse management, last-mile logistics, moving and relocation, and packaging and courier services. It also offers personnel transportation services to corporates, industrial parks, and hotels; student transportation services to schools and colleges; and tourism services for private groups. In addition, the company rents buses and vans for corporate events, tourism, and special events; and provides advertising solutions. It offers its services under the Transportadora EGOBA, Muebles y Mudanzas MYM, Grupo SID, Auto Express Frontera Norte, Autotransportes El Bisonte, and Redpack brand names. The company was formerly known as Fondo de Transporte México, S.A.P.I. de C.V. and changed its name to Grupo Traxión, S.A.B. de C.V. in September 2017. Grupo Traxión, S.A.B. de C.V. is based in Mexico City, Mexico.
